response.overview: This short documentary depicts the importance of music in the lives of young people in Ballymun, highlighting the broad appeal of rap and rave music. The footage features interviews with three young musicians from the area: rapper Daniel McDonnell (credited here as ‘Danny Pepper’ who would later go by Lunitic), Gavin Ward, and Mikey Mooney.
response.title: Ballymun Rap & Rave
